title: ID0418051-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / S4 170003489] Dispenser connection
description:
A dispenser connection was made on this device but the dispenser did not work. The distance between SichargeD and the Dispenser is 20 meters. As I know, there may be problems over 10 meters.
What can we do about this?
Also, can you explain why it does not work over 10 meters technically?

additional_info.subject: ID0418051-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / S4 170003489] Dispenser connection CRM:00315002547
additional_info.body:
Hi Emre-abi,
I sent the ticket to your queue for the Fuse check, I checked the manual of the dispenser and it says this:
The maximum permissible distance between SiD and Dispenser is 10m. The main issue should be voltage drops due to the higher length of the cable. From our side, it's clear that the instructions says 10m maximum, and you should follow it.
Thanks!
BR,
Francisco
